Every page puts the Tumed on the 'Tümed plain' at Hohhot (Hohhot page: 1557, 1575). The Hohhot plain is added; the western reading is kept as Cliopatria's Right Wing outline, unverified (no page opened gives an outline). No infobox area on any Tumed page. fx-34 (F289): the Xinjiang block (Cliopatria's Dzungaria and Tian Shan lands, 2,222 cells) is subtracted. The Altan Khan page names only the Right Wing, the Tumed ulus 'north of the border with Shanxi, in present-day Inner Mongolia', the Ordos, Köke Khota (Hohhot) and, in 1552, Karakorum, and has no campaign, holding or border in Dzungaria, the Tian Shan, Hami or Turpan; the Turpan Khanate page has Turpan, the northern Tarim and, from 1513, Hami under the Turpan khans. 464 of the cells (Turpan and Hami) were claimed by both and went to Turpan by the size rule; the rest of the block is unattested for Altan. notes: Cliopatria's Tümed row (1547-1699) is not the Tumed of the pages. Its 1547-1581 shapes are the western Mongol lands (Dzungaria, the Tian Shan, Qinghai, western Mongolia) with Hohhot added only in 1552; its 1582-1699 shapes are a Qinghai remnant with no cell at Hohhot. The pages put the Tumed on the Tümed plain at Hohhot throughout, so the verdicts add the Hohhot plain to 1547 and replace the 1582-1699 shapes with it (wrong). The Qinghai remnant is not claimed for any state in this dossier: Güshi Khan beat Choghtu near Qinghai Lake in 1637 (khoshut-khanate). End: Cliopatria runs to 1699; the dossier ends in 1635 because the Manchus gained control of the Inner Mongolian tribes then (Inner Mongolia page), the Tumed page has the Tumed submitting to the Qing 'in the early 17th century' without a year, and the mongol-khanate dossier ends the Chahar in 1635. 1635 is confidence 2. Counterparts: khalkha has no dossier (Cliopatria draws the Khalkha lands as 'Golden Horde' rows, marked wrong in the golden-horde dossier; the mongol-khanate dossier uses the same counterpart string); the Oirats of 1552 had no state row, so Karakorum is a gain from khalkha in Cliopatria's accounting although the pages say from the Oirats. The Ming dossier should carry the 1570-71 vassal-tributary relationship (vassal_start tumed). The later-jin-dynasty dossier should carry the 1632-1635 Tumed alliance and submission as a vassal_start with counterpart tumed. Unsettled: the outline of Altan's realm (no page opened gives one); the Kokonor expeditions and the Chabcial meeting with Sonam Gyatso in 1577-78 (the Altan page has the 1569 invitation, 1577 meeting and 1578 'Dalai' title, but no campaign); the founding year of Kökeqota (before 1557); whether Tumed groups lived in Qinghai (a 1623 Tumed abduction in Tibet appears on the Tsangpa page opened for khoshut-khanate). Spelling: the page title 'Altan Khan of the Tümed' loads as Altan_Khan_of_the_Tumed; the diacritic forms failed. No infobox on the Tumed or Altan Khan pages, so no area comparison.
